name: Enabled On
description: A GitHub App or first-party platform service is enabled on a repository — a github_app (e.g. Dependabot) or the Actions OIDC issuer (token.actions.githubusercontent.com), which every repo's workflows use to mint identity tokens. An app_installation is also a source: the installation is what actually reaches a repository, and an installation with repository_selection `all` reaches repositories nobody granted it individually.
